questions.question: Write a pseudocode function to find the closest value to a target in an array.
questions.ideal_answer: The function should take an array and a target value as input. It initializes the minimum difference and the closest value. It then iterates through each element in the array, calculating the absolute difference between the current element and the target. If this difference is smaller than the minimum difference found so far, it updates the minimum difference and the closest value. Finally, it returns or prints the closest value found.
